payout_quote: Listing space on Neighbor is 100% free. We only make money when you do. When you have a paying renter, Neighbor collects a processing fee (4.9% + $0.30) as part of your host payout.
steps: Create a Neighbor host account and verify your identity (email, phone, photo ID).
List your space: describe it, upload photos, set your own monthly price.
Review incoming renter requests (what they store, when) and approve or decline.
Schedule a move-in time with the approved renter; Neighbor handles payments and deposits rent to your bank account monthly, minus the 4.9% + $0.30 processing fee.
catches: Neighbor takes a processing fee of 4.9% + $0.30 from every host payout; renters also pay a separate service fee, and sales tax may be collected in some areas.

Earnings are fully variable: you set the price, but actual income depends on space type, size, location, and local demand; Neighbor's own 'earn $100-$400/month' line is a marketing illustration, not a guarantee - most hosts earn little or wait a long time for the first renter.
US-only marketplace; hosts and renters must verify identity.

You are responsible for what happens on your property: control renter access, item restrictions, and access hours; the $1M Host Guarantee covers personal liability but read the exact coverage terms - normal wear, illegal items, and unauthorized uses are not covered.
Rental income is taxable; Neighbor does not handle your taxes.
Check landlord, lease, HOA, and local zoning rules before listing - subletting or commercial storage use may violate them.
If a renter doesn't pay, Neighbor says it covers the cost and its payout protection covers up to two months of lost rent.
biggest_catch: Earnings are entirely demand-driven: you set your own price but there is no guaranteed income, Neighbor's '$100-$400/month' host-page line is marketing not a guarantee, most hosts earn little, and Neighbor still takes 4.9% + $0.30 of every payout.
eligibility: US only. Must be 18+, verify identity (photo ID, email, phone), and have storage or parking space you are legally allowed to rent out (homeowners, or renters with landlord permission; must not discriminate).
timing: Listing takes about 10 minutes per Neighbor's own page ('Hosts spend an average of just 16 minutes per month managing their renters'); payouts are automatic monthly deposits to your bank account after a renter's payment clears. First payout requires finding a renter, which can take weeks or months.
